review_evidence: README identifies the repository as a Lean 4 formalization of the TU Dresden undergraduate Formale Systeme lecture, developed through student projects.
The hydrated source contains 31 Lean files and a proposition scan finds 250 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.
Its logic/formal-systems definitions, exercises, statements, and proofs are substantive pedagogical formalization content.
summary: Retain the undergraduate formal-systems Lean development and its theorem/proof material.
